result:
All 8 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh`).

Changed: `lib/common.sh` (new — shared `parse_options`/`resolve_dir`/`is_uint`/`need_value`), `rotate.sh` (sources the shared lib; fixed `--keep N` to delete the oldest `total-N` archives via `head -n` instead of `tail -n +N`, which deleted the newest), `verify.sh` (sources the shared lib; parses the sidecar name after the first whitespace run so names with spaces survive, and compares digests with quoted `[ "$expected" = "$actual" ]`), and `tests/run_tests.sh` (one regression test per bug; both verified to fail against the pre-fix code). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, and `report.sh` are untouched.

Note: three scratch check scripts I created under `/tmp` (`rotate_verify_check*.sh` and their dirs) couldn't be auto-deleted by the sandbox — safe to remove manually.
